responsibility: Implements the formatted-output analysis pass for sprintf-family calls. It parses format strings, estimates ranges of produced output lengths using constant folding, MPFR-based floating formatting, object-size and string-length information, diagnoses likely overflows or truncation under -Wformat-overflow/-Wformat-truncation, and under -fprintf-return-value folds safe printf-family return values and simplifies dependent code when the result is computable.
